labeled_from: Prepared remarks, CFO outlook paragraph beginning 'let me turn the outlook for the first quarter of fiscal 2021'.
notes: Every figure here is guidance for FY2021Q1, given on the FY2020Q4 call (2020-02-13). NVDA has a January fiscal year end, so the fiscal year guided is the one closing January 2021. 'Plus or minus 50 basis points' is +/-0.5 percentage points, applied to each basis separately -- GAAP 65% becomes 64.5-65.5 and non-GAAP 65.4% becomes 64.9-65.9. OI&E has no dedicated metric in the enum, so it is labeled 'other' with a metric_detail.
